description.narrative: The project is implemented in Turkey. The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights and peace and dialogue. The main right holders are those who suffer from human rights violations in the south-east Turkey, human rights defenders and actors in the civil society organisations and the government bodies.Through trainings, organising and mobilising, advocacy and capacity building the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is implemented by the local organisation Human Rights Association in Diyarbakir, which mainly works with monitoring, documenting and reporting of the human rights violations in the south east and east Turkey. The Palme Center will support the project with administrative and technical support. Furthermore, the Union of Professionals (Akademikerförbundet SSR) is sponsor organisation in the project.Other Donors to the OrganisationThere are no other donors in the project, or to the local organisation.Project ObjectiveThe project's objective is to contribute to the prevention of serious human rights violations through creating legal tactics and effective prevention methods with the collaboration of lawyers, human rights defenders and CSO representatives, despite the resistance of the law enforcement officials on legal amendments. Furthermore, the project aims to bring the human rights situation in Turkey in line with international human rights standards as applied by the European Convention of Human Rights.Actor groupsThe main actors are human rights defenders (actors working in cooperation), those who are exposed to human rights violations, women, disadvantaged groups, and other minority groups (rights holders).Another actor group is network human rights organisations working together to create awareness and and carrying out collective attempts with human rights organizations (actors working in cooperation).
